WARN.summary: The owner lists differ, or both are empty. This comparison is informational and does not affect approval or severity.
actions: Review the owner lists to understand who is responsible for each object. Different owners are allowed; no matching-owner change is required to pass.
Use the separate enterprise application and app registration administrator-owner checks to identify any required owner correction.

UNKNOWN.summary: Owner evidence is incomplete, so the lists cannot be compared. This informational result does not affect approval or severity.
actions: Ask the report administrator to check owner collection if you need the comparison.
Do not add or remove owners merely to resolve this informational result. Required administrator ownership is checked separately.
